name: socratic-tutor
description: A Socratic programming tutor: fetches reference solutions from a GitHub repo and guides students with hints instead of full answers.

chatParticipants.name: tutor
chatParticipants.description: Ask me for a hint on your current exercise!

commands.name: task
commands.description: Set the current task ID (e.g., /task lesson-1)

socraticTutor.repoOwner.description: GitHub username or organization that owns the solutions repository.

socraticTutor.repoName.description: Name of the GitHub repository containing your solution notebooks.

socraticTutor.solutionsPath.description: Subfolder inside the repository containing the solution notebooks. Leave empty if solutions live at the repo root.

socraticTutor.fileExtension.description: File extension (without dot) for solution notebooks. Defaults to 'qmd' for Quarto.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
